findings.title: Auto matrix silently runs declared-title endpoint HUP
findings.contract: C004 normal Auto/no-title integration and exact first-primary/cleanup outcomes; review brief realhost defaults and kernel HUP branches.
findings.finding: The helper sets CJTUI_020_HOST_AUTO=0 unconditionally. The Auto directory actually records DeclaredSupported-title-stress and the same title-failure primary as the declared directory. Both final endpoint runs cover the declared-title path; 64 passing directories in the Auto command do not prove 64 Auto processes.
findings.coverageGap: Auto/no-title endpoint destruction, whose EOF branch must have terminal write failed primary and terminal restore failed additional, is absent. The 63 safe Auto processes remain valid.
findings.requiredChange: Honor or explicitly parameterize the requested session policy and freeze separate exact title/no-title HUP outcomes from native return classification. Verify and label the actual policy in each endpoint capture/check; run only the affected new coverage after fixing the test.

findings.title: Host runner does not observe application-PTY termios restoration
findings.contract: C004 exact termios/raw restoration with actual-host evidence; host-plan.md lines 7-12 and 78-81.
findings.finding: script creates a child PTY for Application. The before/after stty comparison measures the outer terminal, restored by script itself. The native observer records child raw-active and close return/handlers/buffer, but neither original child termios nor post-close child termios. host_verify therefore cannot certify exact restoration of the terminal Application changed.
findings.coverageGap: Real-host runner can pass if child termios is wrong after a nominally successful close; outer equality and raw-active are not child restoration evidence. Existing standalone PTY comparisons remain valid for their own configurations.
findings.requiredChange: Observe and compare all termios fields on the same actual application endpoint before open and after each safe close, retaining originals and asserting them in the host oracle. Keep destroyed-HUP restoration explicitly unavailable. Do not repair or reset termios to make the observation pass.

findings.title: Combined-error oracle accepts additional unexpected cleanup failures
findings.contract: C004 exact outcomes and reactive-runtime R017 ordered primary/additional errors.
findings.finding: For callback-cleanup and callback-close, verify_records tests only substring membership of each expected extra. A list containing the expected failure plus unrelated or duplicated failures passes. HUP uses exact equality and is not affected.
findings.coverageGap: Ordinary combined-error rows do not enforce the complete literal cleanup list/cardinality/order.
findings.requiredChange: Compare parsed cleanup lines to first_extras exactly and add a negative fixture for an extra/duplicate cleanup error.

findings.title: PTY known-cursor oracle checks restoration only for first run
findings.contract: C004 same-Application restart and I015 original visibility restoration for each managed run.
findings.finding: verify_wire splits both sessions for paste ordering but checks mode25 change/restoration only on first. In a known-hidden restart the base caret is visible, so second-run show must be followed by hidden restoration; a missing second-run hide passes this PTY oracle. Actual-host final mode25 probing supplies a separate check when executed.
findings.coverageGap: Current PTY second-run native visibility restoration is not asserted; logical empty caret and focus do not prove terminal mode25.
findings.requiredChange: Check each session against its frozen original/managed caret behavior, including second hidden restoration after paste cleanup, without requiring redundant restoration when visibility never changed.
